summary: Reconciliation of eight vehicle_physics source proposals into a conservative engine map. The per-vehicle runtime/state object (VehicleRuntimeState) absorbs nine overlapping proposals (VehiclePhysicsBody x2, VehiclePhysicsObject, Vehicle x2, F1CVehicle, VehicleControlState, PhysicsStateBuffer, VehicleTireModel) on the cross-call graph plus the shared +0x32BC/+0x32C8 gates and the shared orientation/world block; common ownership stays DERIVED/GUESS. The suspension-strut array object (VehiclePhysicsNode) absorbs the wheel-surface resolver on shared +0x130/+0x134 fields and shared callees. Tire-model config data (VehicleTireModelData) absorbs the sub-init helpers. SVM/HDV configuration loading (VehicleConfigLoader) groups the parser hub, validator and section readers. Collision handling (CollisionSystem), input/AI control, list containers, math and solver state form smaller families. All per-proposal interfaces, state machines, dependencies and compatibility contracts are preserved; contradictions are recorded in conflicts and unplaceable evidence is carried in unresolved_evidence_refs.

engine_subsystems.name: VehiclePhysicsRuntime
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle physics, control and lifecycle: timestep and integration, suspension/spring-damper/tire force solving, per-vehicle state reset/clear, and the physics-mode dispatch.

engine_subsystems.name: VehicleSuspensionAndWheelModel
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Suspension-strut contact solving, swept collision detection, wheel-surface contact resolution, per-wheel spring/damper and parameter evaluation, suspension snapshotting and the per-frame force propagation chain.

engine_subsystems.name: VehicleCollisionAndSpatial
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Collision normal resolution, broadphase AABB building and collision object-list management over the global free pool; spatial-grid feature queries.

engine_subsystems.name: VehicleConfigurationLoading
engine_subsystems.responsibility: SVM/HDV vehicle configuration parsing and validation, tire-model data construction, engine/damage/per-wheel section loading, and the physics matrix row identity initializer.

engine_subsystems.name: VehicleControlAndAI
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Input smoothing and gear selection, AI gear-shift and relative-speed control, velocity/angular-velocity integration, per-car physics state construction, track-environment parameter init, vehicle/name list construction and qualifying tire-usage recording.

engine_subsystems.name: MathAndSolverState
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Coordinate-frame math: 3x3 transforms, inverse coordinate transforms and the global solver-state zero-initializer.

canonical_type_families.name: VehicleRuntimeState
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-vehicle physics, control and state object (the 'this' base shared across the per-frame physics update, control tick, timestep, reset/clear and property-set paths). Carries the physics-mode selector (+0x32BC) and F1CUI vehicle mode (+0x32C8), the wheel-dynamics/per-wheel records (stride-62 dword blocks at +0x35A0/+0x35B0 and 248-byte wheel blocks at +0x3664), the 3x3 orientation matrix + world position block (+0x34B0..+0x34DC), integration fields (+0x3498..+0x34AC), per-frame spring/damper and tire force solving, respawn/reset and cleanup, audio config, yaw-recovery counters, collision damage feedback thresholds and the driver-info/property region (+0x4620..+0x48BC).
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Field samples are boundary clues to one large per-vehicle object; the four different per-wheel block descriptions (74-float stride at +0xD4, 62-dword records at +0x35A0/+0x35B0, 248-byte blocks at +0x3664, 1124-byte wheel strides at +0x5D8) are kept as distinct sub-blocks and are NOT unified because no evidence defines their relationship. Member proposals were merged on the cross-call graph plus the shared +0x32BC/+0x32C8 gates and the shared orientation/world block; common ownership is DERIVED/GUESS, not packet-proven.

canonical_type_families.name: VehiclePhysicsNode
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Owns the vehicle suspension-strut array (count +0x130, array base +0x134, 316-byte stride) and the per-frame suspension solver chain: per-strut contact solving, swept contact detection, wheel-surface contact resolution against the spatial structure dword_5EA2C0, and tire/grip force propagation with distance falloff.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: This+0x130 count / this+0x134 array base with 316-byte stride is shared by the strut solver (VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation chain) and the wheel surface resolver; strut-relative offsets (+24/+72/+112..+156/+268/+272) are raw-source prose, not field evidence. Merged on shared array fields and the shared callees 0x004FAF60/0x004FB260.

canonical_type_families.name: VehicleTireModelData
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-vehicle tire model configuration data constructed once (ABI lead Tire_Model_Data_Init, LEGACY): handle sentinels (0/-1), compound count 15, friction/camber/slip coefficient seeding, physics-default sub-structs, zero-init regions, and the config-path string copy from global 0x005EA438.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Header handle sentinels, compound count and zero-init regions are boundary clues; per-compound coefficient tables are not enumerated as fields. Sub-init helpers (PhysicsDefaultsInitializer, tireModelZeroInit) are treated as methods on the same data object via the TireModelDataInit call graph.

canonical_type_families.name: VehicleConfigLoader
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Vehicle configuration loading: line-by-line .SVM/.HDV parsing (the parser hub 0x004F4270), default/override validation with path commit, and the named section readers (damage model, engine + engine-map field definitions, per-wheel brake/suspension, damping-direction validation, suspension-setup section) that normalize range/setting pairs into the setup struct and the output vehicle-state struct.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Reader objects write into the parser's setup struct; individual reader 'this' bases (EngineSetup at +0x68C.., PerWheelBrakeSuspensionDataLoader +0xB8, TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser engine-map doubles +0x674/+0x67C) are preserved as distinct field identities per rule 8 and are not unified. Merged on the configuration-loading responsibility and the parser-hub call graph.

canonical_type_families.name: CollisionSystem
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Collision handling: oriented collision-normal resolution from spatial-grid feature plane coefficients (0x0044C550), broadphase AABB list building/clipping (0x00490EE0), and the per-frame collision object-list manager (re-sort, minimum-tolerance removal, drain to the global free pool, filtering) over 16-byte {head,tail,anchor,count} linked-list records and collision nodes.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: LinkedList {head,tail,anchor,count} at 0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC is DERIVED; collision node +0x0 value / +0x4 next (also a float sort key) / +0x8 flag byte / +0x370 distance are the read fields, +0xC is listed but unread. Merged on the shared collision-list responsibility and the free-pool protocol on dword_8AB700.

canonical_type_families.name: VehicleInputController
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle input processor: ramps per-axis smoothed accumulators toward direct targets with mode==2 passthrough, sign-aware steering return-to-center, and gear selection from the gear-flag ladder with neutral override.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Accumulator/flag fields at +0x1B20..+0x2428 are boundary clues; the exact gear-flag to gear mapping (+0x1FBC/+0x1FE8/+0x2014/+0x2040/+0x206C/+0x2098/+0x20C4) is DERIVED fill naming, not packet-proven.

canonical_type_families.name: VehiclePhysicsIntegrator
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-frame velocity/angular-velocity integrator: reads physics coefficients and position/orientation/rotation state, branches on the contact count, integrates, composes transforms, renders the sprite grid and exchanges remote-vehicle state via network codecs.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Integrator coefficients (+0x28..+0x50) and work-block outputs (+0x218..+0x234) are boundary clues; the body is truncated in the packet so exact ordering is unrecoverable.

canonical_type_families.name: TrackEnvironmentManager
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Track-environment physics parameter container: a track-type selector at +0x3B40 dispatches to one of four profiles that initialize a dense run of clamped float parameter slots and a nested per-wheel 2x8 array.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Parameter slots are clamped {value, lower, upper} triples; the physical meaning of each slot (grip, wear, temperature...) is not deterministically evidenced.

canonical_type_families.name: CarPhysicsState
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Large per-car physics state object (DWORD array up to this[998]): zeroed leading/middle arrays, sentinel and default blocks, sub-initializer forwards, and a QPC timer configuration block.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: State-word runs are boundary clues; the sentinel 0/-1 blocks and the config block this[617..623] = 4/2/2/0/0/0/0 semantics are not established.

canonical_type_families.name: QualifyingTireUsageRecorder
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Records qualifying tire-usage ring-buffer events: during a qualifying session advances the ring buffer and encodes tire set in-use/discard events with session-time payload and tire-compound byte.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: VehicleId (+0x4) and TireCompound (+0x34) are the only field samples; event ids 26/27 come from existing-analysis prose, not raw source.

canonical_type_families.name: VehicleListContainer
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Holds two linked lists rebuilt from the global vehicle array (dword_8AC390 count, dword_8AC394 base, stride 1060): the vehicle list (this+0x0..0xC) and the deduplicated commentary name list (this+0x10..0x1C).
canonical_type_families.field_policy: List head/tail/secondary/count slots are boundary clues; node-internal layouts are GUESS.

canonical_type_families.name: RelativeSpeedCalculator
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Computes signed relative speed between the owning AI object and a target vehicle: longitudinal closing speed via dot product or lateral speed via 2D cross product, with a normalized longitudinal speed.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Target fields at obj+0x34E0..0x3500 are read via the this+0x0 target pointer; the target object type is not named.

canonical_type_families.name: GearShiftController
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-frame AI gear-shift control over vehicle state fields: shift-timer block, reverse/pit-mode force requests, RPM-threshold upshift with traction guard and max-gear cap.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Shift fields at +0x37CC..+0x4510 are boundary clues; the JUMPOUT(0x4F62E6) downshift tail lies outside the packet.

canonical_type_families.name: SuspensionPhysicsSnapshot
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-frame snapshot of suspension physics state: copies collision-geometry and wheel/damper and force/torque blocks from the source physics object, evaluates quadratic spring/force/torque terms from a parameter descriptor, and mirrors selected results.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Snapshot fields at +0x17A8..+0x1C4C are boundary clues; duplicate re-copies in the source are treated as redundant double-writes.

canonical_type_families.name: WheelSpringDamperState
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-wheel spring/damper force computation: builds the suspension frame, computes spring/damper forces from wheel velocity, clamps to the friction/grip circle and writes force components along the wheel local axes.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Wheel-local fields (+0x18..+0xE0) are boundary clues; the a2 contact-patch frame (9 floats) layout is inferred from usage and not packet-described.

canonical_type_families.name: WheelParameterEvaluator
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-frame wheel parameter evaluator: computes linear combinations of three scalar inputs against coefficient/bias doubles (this+0x3F4..+0x530) producing two force magnitudes and a combined output.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Coefficient/bias doubles are boundary clues; the a6 output is computed but never read inside the function.

canonical_type_families.name: PhysicsStateBuffer
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Small physics state buffer object cleared per-frame: zeroes dwords 0..38 of a 40-dword buffer and frees/nulls the heap pointer at +0x9C, returning the previous pointer.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Only the +0x9C heap pointer is field-evidenced; the 40-dword contents are not enumerated.

canonical_type_families.name: Matrix3x3
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Row-major 3x3 double matrix used as a linear-algebra transform; F_3DVectorTransformBy33Matrix multiplies a difference vector by this matrix and writes the result to the output vector.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Nine doubles at +0x0..+0x40; row-major convention is GUESS.

canonical_type_families.name: MatrixTransformWorkspace
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Holds input matrix/vector pointers and a result buffer; computeInverse3x3CoordinateTransform reads two matrix blocks, transforms two input vectors via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, assembles cofactor-based inverse-matrix rows and matrix-vector products into the result buffer (this+0x10) and returns a pointer into it.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Pointer slots +0x4/+0x8/+0xC and the result buffer at +0x10 are boundary clues; result elements this+0x28..+0x80 are grouped by source region only.

canonical_type_families.name: PhysicsSolverState
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Hypothesized single owner of the global physics/dynamics solver state region (base 0x008D2120, span ~0x1860 bytes) that PhysicsStateZeroInit zero-initializes via direct double assignments and block clears through sub_58BB10.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: The region is evidenced only as named globals (global:0x008D...), never object-relative fields; the 58 cleared locations are carried as class-level evidence refs. Common ownership is a GUESS.

canonical_type_families.name: VehicleBodyObject
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Object reached by dereferencing this[0] (packet 'obj' base): carries the post-process input state dword (+0x4064), an off-track distance (+0x4170, FLT_MAX sentinel), a mode/lap-line field (+0x3450) and the instance id (+0x4894) that gates the vehicle sound trigger.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Four field samples only; identity with the 'this' base is NOT established.

canonical_type_families.name: MotionLineEntity
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Position+direction line object (packet bases *(this+0x10C) own data block and *(this+0x110) target1): position at +0x94/+0x9C, direction at +0xA4/+0xAC, plus an internal self pointer (+0x110) on target1. Consumed by VehicleProximity for closest-approach projection.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Nine field samples across two bases; not merged with ProximityTargetEntity because the target2 layout (+0x0/+0x8) differs.

canonical_type_families.name: ProximityTargetEntity
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Second proximity target object (packet base *(this+0x114)): a different layout from the motion-line objects, exposing position at +0x0/+0x8 only. Used by VehicleProximity's target2 projection.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Two field samples only; layout differs from MotionLineEntity so the two are kept separate.

state_machines.name: VehiclePhysicsMode
states: Mode0_FullUpdate: integrate wheel-space transform chain, update HUD 43/44, query body motion, run per-wheel collision/suspension geometry, trigger vehicle sound on instance-id match
Mode1_VelocityThreshold: velocity-threshold variant falling through into the shared integration
Mode2_SharedIntegration_Torque: shared integration plus wheel-torque accumulation and per-wheel suspension/vibration updates
Mode3_DelegateTimestep: delegate to VehiclePhysicsTimeStep for the referenced vehicle
Mode0_init: +0x32BC == 0 selects one-time TireModelInit into dbl_7C7428 then the step path
InvalidOrIdle: mode outside [0,3] -> early return without stepping
transitions: field this+0x32BC == 0 -> full update / init path
field this+0x32BC == 1 -> velocity-threshold variant
field this+0x32BC == 2 -> shared integration with torque accumulation
field this+0x32BC == 3 -> delegate to VehiclePhysicsTimeStep (0x004C73F0)
field this+0x32BC outside [0,3] -> early return / unhandled

state_machines.name: VehicleTimestepModeDispatch
states: mode 2 = full setup-data copy + 14 subsystem state machines
mode 3 = vibration path + 4 vibration state machines + 14 subsystem state machines
other modes = no mode-specific body; all paths converge on effect/audio flag derivation
transitions: this+0x32C8 is read each frame; values 2 and 3 dispatch distinct bodies, everything else skips the mode body
both mode bodies end in the common braking/effect/bit-flag derivation and effect-field update

state_machines.name: GearSelection
transitions: Gear-input flag ladder at +0x1FBC..+0x20C4 selects reverse/gears 1..6 when the ladder enable byte at +0x2428 is nonzero; no flag leaves UNSELECTED (-2)
Neutral override at +0x20F0 == 0 and global byte_7D1370 == 1 force NEUTRAL (0) when the ladder is still UNSELECTED
Gear-output slots outside the ladder (0x20F0 != 0) force the highest gear value 7

state_machines.name: GearShiftControl
transitions: Default -> BlockedByTimer when shift_timer(this+0x3A10) > 0
Default -> ReverseRequest when driverStatus(this+0x4510) == 6
Default -> PitModeNeutral when carConditions(this+0x3D6C) == 2
Default -> UpshiftReady when engine_rpm(this+0x39A0) > shift_rpm_threshold(this+0x3A18) and traction > 0.8 and current_gear(this+0x39FC) < max_gear(this+0x3A04)
Default -> DownshiftTail via JUMPOUT(0x4F62E6) when current_gear(this+0x39FC) > 1

state_machines.name: SurfaceContactResolution
transitions: PrimaryQuery -> ContactAccepted when element+300 >= this+0x10 and nearest-neighbor hit (flag 1) found
PrimaryQuery -> SecondaryPlaneTest when element+300 == 1 and element+276 still null
SecondaryPlaneTest -> ContactCleared when |signed plane distance| outside hit bounds
SecondaryPlaneTest -> ContactAccepted when within bounds, copying element+296 from the hit chain

state_machines.name: PitLimiterHudState
states: state 1 = pit limiter engaged (calls HUDElementConfig(41, 2, blend))
state 2 = pit limiter with weather-noise blend, cleared when throttle output this+0x8 < 0.8
transitions: state 0 -> 1 when pit flag dword_7CC368 set, this+0x1D34 != 0, this+0x1EF0 == 0 and vehicle state mode this+0xD0 != 2
state 1 -> 2 when the pit flag clears
state 2 is cleared when throttle output drops below 0.8

state_machines.name: TireWearModeSwitch
states: wear mode 0 = wear disabled: NaN-boxed max double written to this+0x1DB8 and the four wheel wear blocks zeroed
wear modes 1..3 = wheel wear blocks scaled by flt_8ACF9C over 4 iterations
transitions: read global dword_7CEA5C: 0 selects disable, 1..3 select scaling
when session type dword_7C56A4 == 7, this+0x1DB4 is additionally divided by flt_8ACF9C

state_machines.name: VehicleYawRecovery
states: NonZero_Accumulating: state dword obj+0x4064 non-zero; accumulate frame time at this+0x4004; past 15.0 reset counters and fire the audio effect in session 7
Zero_RecoveryCheck: state dword zero; off-track guard then nearest-path and lateral-bound recovery decision
RecoveryTriggered: reset counters, set this+0x3D60 = 2, emit render/AI-tracking notifications in session 7
transitions: Entry -> NonZero_Accumulating when obj+0x4064 != 0 and this+0x32BC == 1 and state != 2
NonZero_Accumulating -> itself when accumulator at this+0x4004 > 15.0 (reset counters; audio effect in session 7)
Entry -> Zero_RecoveryCheck when obj+0x4064 == 0
Zero_RecoveryCheck -> RecoveryTriggered when accumulator exceeds flt_7D0A8C and off-track and lateral distance below 7.0 / bound test fails

state_machines.name: CollisionFeedbackGating
transitions: this[0] == dword_7C54E8 and gate bytes clear -> primary (player) feedback path
identity differs and restricted-mode flag != 1 -> main body runs
identity differs and race phase not in {1,3} -> main body runs
identity differs, restricted-mode flag == 1 and race phase in {1,3} -> suppressed

interfaces.name: SpatialGridQueryService
interfaces.purpose: Spatial-grid contact lookup and collision-surface normal extraction used by the suspension contact solver.

interfaces.name: TireForceSolverService
interfaces.purpose: Per-strut tire, grip and lateral force computation used by the swept contact pass and the per-frame force-propagation pass.

interfaces.name: MatrixTransformLibrary
interfaces.purpose: 3x3 matrix-vector transforms, rotation tensors, Euler-to-rotation and coordinate-frame conversions shared across steering, suspension and physics-step code.

interfaces.name: PackedPacketDecoder
interfaces.purpose: Decodes the packed per-frame input packet into orientation components, steering bitfields, per-wheel data, velocity short-vectors, floats and subsystem bits.

interfaces.name: TireCompoundResolution
interfaces.purpose: Resolve the tire brand (TireBrandLookup on global table 0x008AD254 with the session compound id a3+136) and then the compound index (CompoundIndexLookup on the brand pointer and the compound selection) into the two base pointers into the compound data used by the wheel force evaluation.

interfaces.name: SuspensionForceEvaluation
interfaces.purpose: Per-wheel suspension and tire force helper models: suspension force split (VehicleSuspensionForceHelper), quadratic/cubic polynomial evaluators, tire force/torque computation, quadratic force model, linear vehicle parameter evaluation, and quadratic force/torque curve evaluation, whose outputs feed the force summation.

interfaces.name: WheelStateInitialization
interfaces.purpose: Initialize the per-wheel suspension/tire state from the wheel index, contact offset pointer, and steering-direction magnitudes (WheelSuspensionTireStateInit).

interfaces.name: RuntimeParameterHelpers
interfaces.purpose: Auxiliary runtime value generators used by the per-frame update: parameterized torque-curve interpolation, random offset and bias value computation, arithmetic comparison/validation, and float-to-int conversion and allocation count arithmetic.

interfaces.name: AllocationAndSystemServices
interfaces.purpose: Memory allocation and system helper services: operator-new wrapper and float-to-int conversion, LCG random seeding, triple-field position query, vertex/particle buffer allocation, direction-vector projection, and config-path string copy with reallocation.

interfaces.name: SimulationServices
interfaces.purpose: Simulation-level services invoked from the per-frame update and the tire model data constructor: session-state indexed lookup, pit-part state copy, engine wear/failure simulation, 3x3 matrix transform with translation, loop-with-conditional-subcall, and the zero-init/sub-constructor helpers.

interfaces.name: ConfigTokenReader
interfaces.purpose: Low-level token/line readers and section-header matcher used by the SVM/HDV parser to decode individual config lines into typed values and to route lines to section readers.

interfaces.name: GlobalVehicleArray
interfaces.purpose: Shared global vehicle array (dword_8AC390 count, dword_8AC394 base, stride 1060) consumed by the vehicle-list and name-list builders and by configuration validation to index vehicle entries.

interfaces.name: PhysicsParseBuffer
interfaces.purpose: Global session parse buffer byte_7C56C0 used both as the target of SVM/HDV vehicle-file parsing and as the global setter buffer for wheel-dynamics parameter pushes.

interfaces.name: SpatialNearestNeighborQuery
interfaces.purpose: Spatial structure (dword_5EA2C0) backing wheel-surface contact resolution via SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest.

interfaces.name: ICollisionNormalProvider
interfaces.purpose: Provide the oriented collision normal for a query position against the spatial-grid collision features.

interfaces.name: IVehicleInputProcessor
interfaces.purpose: Produce per-frame smoothed control outputs (steering, throttle, brake, clutch, handbrake) and a gear selection from raw input state.

interfaces.name: IVehiclePropertySetter
interfaces.purpose: Set a single vehicle property/state dword (this[4651]) and return the written value.

interfaces.name: TireBrushModelService
interfaces.purpose: Tire-brush force model: per-frame force/torque solving with a lock protocol (1 = acquire, 0 = release) and per-wheel contact/spring-damper helpers.

interfaces.name: VehicleHdvParser
interfaces.purpose: Vehicle .hdv file parsing and session/tire-model scratch initializers shared by config and audio loading.

interfaces.name: AudioStreamRecordParser
interfaces.purpose: Conditional audio-stream record iteration: open/dispatch/close primitives and restriction/force-field sphere token readers used by vehicle audio config.

interfaces.name: TransformMathService
interfaces.purpose: Rotation/transform math helpers: 3x3 matrix construction, Euler extraction, ride-height delta and coordinate transforms.

interfaces.name: CollisionDamageFeedbackService
interfaces.purpose: Collision damage/spark event services: ring-buffer event encoding, state transitions, per-zone repair-service dispatch and steering-geometry deformation.

interfaces.name: LifecycleResetService
interfaces.purpose: Vehicle substructure lifecycle: multi-system state init/reset, array and dual-array destructors, timer clamp, scale propagation and audio sub-slot initialization.

interfaces.name: CollisionSystemService
interfaces.purpose: Global collision system hooks: conditional resets, contact-zone dispatch, 3D sound-source destruction and string-buffer reallocation.

interfaces.name: MemoryService
interfaces.purpose: Heap scratch allocation/free primitives and stack-buffer cleanup helpers used across physics and audio config paths.

interfaces.name: PhysicsNodePropagationService
interfaces.purpose: Physics-node propagation with distance falloff over the global node set.

interfaces.name: FlagGatedStubService
interfaces.purpose: Compiler/feature-flag stub gates invoked around the tire-contact pass.

interfaces.name: WheelSuspensionGeometry
interfaces.purpose: Per-wheel suspension, collision, vibration and transform helper family operating on a vehicle/wheel context; used by VehiclePhysicsTick and VehicleClimbAdjust.

interfaces.name: ConfigTokenStreamParser
interfaces.purpose: Shared token-stream reading, line decoding and scalar parsing helpers plus the CRT range/setting registration routine, used by all vehicle config parsers (damage, engine, per-wheel brake/suspension, damping validation).

interfaces.name: DebugLogWriter
interfaces.purpose: Debug-log pipeline (string split plus write) used for configuration validation diagnostics gated by session type.

interfaces.name: HudAndSoundTrigger
interfaces.purpose: HUD element configuration and per-vehicle sound/audio effect triggers driven from the per-frame physics update.

interfaces.name: Matrix3x3VectorOps
interfaces.purpose: Transform a 3-element vector by a 3x3 matrix; computeInverse3x3CoordinateTransform calls it on each of the two workspace input vectors (Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, 0x00435E00).

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionForceFormula
compatibility_contracts.description: The temperature-scaled suspension force is computed as (temperature_term + 273.16) * input_factor * 0.002778858444950814 * scale + addend; a replacement must reproduce this arithmetic.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionWheelRecordReturnPointer
compatibility_contracts.description: UpdateSuspensionAndWheelPhysics returns a pointer advanced through four per-wheel 33-double records starting at session+5200 (plus the axis blocks at session+5336/+5864). The caller 0x004E45B0 (LargeConfigFunctionWithPhysicsConstants) uses the returned advanced pointer; a replacement must reproduce the pointer arithmetic.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleFileValidation
compatibility_contracts.description: ValidateVehicleConfigurationFile returns 0 only when both the default and override SVM/HDV parses succeed; on success the parse buffer byte_7C56C0 is cleared, the cost-display mode backup dword_7C56C4 = dword_7D0450 is taken before parsing, and when the commit flag is set the override path is copied into the caller's this+0 / this+8 string slots via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and sub_568B00.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleStateArrayStride
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle state array rooted at global 0x5EC6D8 is indexed by the vehicle index field (this+0x4) with a 18624-byte (0x48C0) stride during VehiclePhysicsTick case-3 delegation to VehiclePhysicsTimeStep.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsStateBufferClearContract
compatibility_contracts.description: PhysicsBufferClear zeroes dwords 0..38 of the 40-dword buffer on the this object, frees the pointer stored at +0x9C through the free wrapper (0x00587BCF) and nulls it, returning the previous pointer (or 0). Callers are ConstructorStub (004353F0), SuspensionSetupSectionReader (00435410) and WheelDynamicsInit (0043E230), so the buffer is reset during vehicle/tire construction and wheel-dynamics initialization.

compatibility_contracts.name: DampingGovernorSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: After each handled physics mode, the damping governor recomputes this+0x105B from v75 = 0.94 - this+0x1030*0.9 against globals flt_8AFECC/8AFEE8/8AFEEC every 16 ticks (counter this+0x4020); external pokes to +0x105B do not persist because the field is recomputed.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsGlobalStateBlocks
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame setup reads global physics state: dword_7C8A18 (physics base; +28 orientation, +100 world position), dword_7C7918 (per-corner camera copy source), dbl_7C7428 (shared tire-model buffer), dword_5EA2C0 (physics node set), and the rotating noise table dword_8AAE70/flt_8AAE74 for randomized delays and damage draws.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsModeGate
compatibility_contracts.description: The flag at vehicle+0x32BC gates two paths: non-zero enables the per-frame suspension body-offset override and the wheel-force field-storage path in SetWheelForceParameters; zero disables the override and routes the same four parameters to a direct rigid-body force/torque application using the dbl_7C7428 scalar as the inertia-tensor argument. A replacement must preserve this gate's effect on both consumers.

compatibility_contracts.name: HudElement43_44Contract
compatibility_contracts.description: VehiclePhysicsTick emits HUDElementConfig(43/44,...) each handled frame driven by the flags this+0x4018 (element 43) and this+0x401C (element 44, scaled by dbl_7C7598*4 clamped to 1.0); a replacement must reproduce these HUD updates or accept missing HUD output.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireModelDataHandleConvention
compatibility_contracts.description: The tire model data object's header uses handle sentinels (primary field 0, other handle slots -1), a compound count of 15, and alternating sentinel/zero handle pairs. Its config path is passed through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc from the global buffer 0x005EA438. A replacement must preserve the handle convention and the config-loading call.

compatibility_contracts.name: Matrix3x3VectorMultiplySemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Matrix3x3VectorMultiply (0x00435E00) transforms an input vector by a 3x3 matrix; computeInverse3x3CoordinateTransform calls it twice on the two workspace input vectors, so a replacement must provide the same 3x3 vector-transform semantics for the two input-vector slots (this+0x04, this+0x08).

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsIntegrationGates
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame physics integration must early-out when the physics-override double at 0x005D6D70 equals 1.0 or the enable byte at 0x007CE254 is zero, must save and restore the FPU control word, and must preserve the RK2 midpoint sub-stepping (half-step wheel-data copies, accumulator this+0x60) over the timestep field this+0x68.

compatibility_contracts.name: PackedInputPacketFormat
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame vehicle input arrives as a packed packet: the region at packet+8 encodes orientation components, a steering bitfield, per-wheel data, a velocity short-vector, floats and subsystem bits decoded by the helper family 0x004B2420..0x004B2AD0. Auxiliary words at packet+52/+56/+59 carry flags: packet+52 bit 0x80 -> byte this+0x1069, packet+56 bits 0x8000000/0x4000000/0x2000000 -> braking byte this+0x105D and effect bytes this+0x1065/0x1067, and packet+59 bit 1 -> byte this+0x4024.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionTypeGatedDiagnostics
compatibility_contracts.description: Debug warnings during configuration load are suppressed when session type dword_7C569C == 5 (server), and recovery/audio notifications require dword_7C56A4 == 7; these globals gate diagnostic and notification side effects and must keep their semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireBrushModelLockProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: Callers of the tire-brush solver must bracket work with TireBrushModelForceSolver(1) to acquire and TireBrushModelForceSolver(0) to release; the physics step and the collision wrapper both follow this protocol.

compatibility_contracts.name: ContactPointOutputBuffer
compatibility_contracts.description: The 13-point contact-position output buffer at vehicle+0x3AB8 (stride 12 bytes) is computed each frame, copied into the 28-byte-stride wheel output array at +0x1078, and consumed by the vertex/particle buffer allocation; the bounding radius is tracked at +0x3B6C with +0x3B70 = +0x3B6C + 0.1. A replacement must produce all 13 points and publish them to +0x1078.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverInfoClearSentinels
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement clearing the vehicle driver-info region must zero the byte fields at 0x4620/0x4660/0x4678/0x46B8/0x46F8/0x4708/0x4714/0x4794, write -1 into dwords 0x4710/0x4898/0x489C/0x48A0/0x48A4/0x48A8, 0 into 0x48AC/0x48B8, -8388609 into 0x48B4 and 11 into 0x48BC.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionNodeFreePoolProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement reusing collision nodes must push drained nodes onto the global free pool through dword_8AB700 (head), dword_8AB704 (tail), dword_8AB708 (used when the pool is empty) and increment dword_8AB70C (count).

compatibility_contracts.name: IntegrationSubstepClamp
compatibility_contracts.description: The integration sub-step count stored at this+0x3498 must be clamped to [1,64]; step-size fields derive as 1.0/(40*v6) and 1.0/(8*(5*v6+5)) and this+0x34AC mirrors the global race-time double.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelDynamicsRecordArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The vehicle physics body owns four wheel-dynamics records at this+0x35A0 with stride 62 dwords. VehiclePhysicsTimeStep stores per-wheel force values at this+0x35BC + i*62 dwords (mode 2), while WheelStateReset re-initializes the records each frame, setting identity 1.0 at record-relative indices 22/23/39 and zeroing the leading accumulator entries, and the first-frame guard this+0x32BC drives WheelDynamicsInit(0x007C7428).

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSessionInitMarkers
compatibility_contracts.description: TireModelFullInitialize ends a session by setting this+0x30 = -2 and this+0x34 = 3 with this+0x38/+0x3C zeroed. VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate reads this+0x30 for the position-change state machine, and VehiclePhysicsTimeStep branches on the vehicle mode this+0x32C8. A replacement must preserve these sentinel semantics across tire-model init, control-state updates and the physics timestep.

compatibility_contracts.name: SvmHdvConfigFileFormat
compatibility_contracts.description: Line-based '='-delimited configuration files with named sections (General, FrontWing, LeftFender, RightFender, RearWing, BodyAero, Diffuser, Suspension, Controls, Engine, Driveline, Frontleft/Frontright/Rearleft/Rearright, Basic). Recognized header keywords include Setting/Notes/Downforce/Balance/Ride/Gearing/Custom/Symmetric. In non-server sessions a file with no recognized header is rejected as an illegal .SVM file. A replacement executable must preserve '=' delimiter handling, section dispatch, and the rejection path.

compatibility_contracts.name: InverseCoordinateTransformResultBuffer
compatibility_contracts.description: computeInverse3x3CoordinateTransform (0x0056D020) writes the inverse-transform result into the workspace buffer at this+0x10 (elements this+0x28 through this+0x80) and returns a pointer into that buffer; callers at 0x00439210 and 0x0056D930 rely on the returned pointer.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleInputSmoothingOutputOrder
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must emit the smoothed control outputs through output pointers in the order a3=steering, a4=throttle, a5=brake, a6=clutch, a7=handbrake, a8=gear, with throttle/brake/clutch/handbrake clamped to the [0,1] float range and the gear output in {-2..7} with the neutral override honoring global byte_7D1370.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionFeedbackRingBuffer
compatibility_contracts.description: Collision spark/damage events are encoded into a 432-byte-strided ring buffer: dword_83EE60 counts live slots (cap 1023), dword_8AAE64 is the advancing slot base, ProgressBarEventEncode writes the slot header and direction bytes at slot+8..+14.

compatibility_contracts.name: GlobalPhysicsSolverStateZeroInit
compatibility_contracts.description: PhysicsStateZeroInit (0x00579CCF) zero-initializes a contiguous global solver-state region beginning at 0x008D2120 and ending with the 272-byte block at 0x008D3870 (span ~0x1860 bytes), mixing direct double assignments with block clears through sub_58BB10; a replacement executable must preserve this global layout and the double alignment of the cleared blocks.

compatibility_contracts.name: SharedPhysicsBufferAndRegistry
compatibility_contracts.description: dbl_7C7428 is the shared suspension/body-motion physics object read and reset by VehicleClimbAdjust, VehicleDynamicsStateReset and VehiclePhysicsTick; dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC] selects the active vehicle whose instance id (obj+0x4894) gates the sound trigger; dword_7C8B44/0x7C8B48 are reset before the trigger.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Consumers of the global vehicle array (dword_8AC390 count, dword_8AC394 base, stride 1060) rely on the driver-name byte at entry+124 and the driver-file path at entry+188; a replacement must preserve those field offsets and the array stride.

compatibility_contracts.name: PerVehiclePhysicsStateLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must preserve the per-vehicle state object ('this' base) layout touched every frame: orientation matrix block +0x34B0..+0x34D0, wheel/setup vectors +0x34D4..+0x350C and +0x3534..+0x3548, world position/velocity +0x10..+0x54, body-motion state +0xFE4..+0xFF8, per-wheel data at +0x35B0 (four entries, 62-dword stride), climb/vibration +0x3994..+0x39C4, and the physics-mode selector at +0x32BC (dispatched by VehiclePhysicsTick and read by VehicleYawRecoveryStateMachine, VehicleDynamicsStateReset and VehicleClimbAdjust).

compatibility_contracts.name: PerWheelStateBlockLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Four per-wheel state blocks of 248-byte stride on the vehicle object (base 0x35AC). The wheel-force field sits at block-relative offset 0x24 (absolute 0x3664/0x375C/0x3854/0x394C): SetWheelForceParameters stores four per-wheel force parameters there, and the per-frame update initializes and reads the same block layout. A replacement must preserve the stride and the block-relative offsets.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehiclePhysicsObjectLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must preserve the vehicle physics-state layout: wheel-state block with 74-float (296-byte) stride based at this+0xD4, 3x3 orientation matrix at 0x34B0..0x34D0, world position at 0x34D4..0x34DC, integration fields at 0x3498..0x34AC, and the 0x3D48..0x3EB8 collision feedback threshold block.

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionSetupSection
compatibility_contracts.description: SuspensionSetupSectionReader must keep the degree-to-radian conversion factor 0.0174532925199433 for orientation fields, the spring-array growth rule (capacity +3 slots of 100 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper with per-slot category init), and the spring classification enums sliding/normal/free-damping (0/1/2).

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionNormalOutputConvention
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must write the normalized collision normal into the caller output vector a3 as { -(v8*v6), v8, -(v8*v7) } with v8 = 1/sqrt(v7*v7 + v6*v6 + 1.0) derived from the feature plane coefficients, and return the spatial-grid query result (feature pointer or NULL).

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionStrutArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The vehicle physics node exposes a suspension strut array at this+0x134 with stride 316 bytes and element count this+0x130. Per strut the solver writes contact state (penetration depths at +112/+116, gravity-compensated contact force at +120/+124/+128), force propagation results at +136/+140 and a candidate force slot at +144, reads the wheel position at +148/+152/+156 and travel scale at +24, and requires linked-node (+268) and contact-feature (+272) pointers to be non-null for contact processing. VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation / SweptSuspensionCollisionDetection / PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff all share this array and per-strut ABI.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsMatrixRowIdentity
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x00578F76 must set exactly one row of the double-precision dynamics matrix to an identity row (diagonal element 1.0, all other stored elements of that row 0.0), selected by argument 0..33, and return the selector argument unchanged on every path.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelSurfaceContactResolution
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame wheel contact pass must preserve the grip-scale formula 1.0 - (flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC)*0.5 stored at this+0x170, the wheel array stride of 316 bytes with count at this+0x130 and base this+0x134, the two nearest-neighbor queries (flag 1 primary, flag 0 secondary signed-plane bound test) on dword_5EA2C0, and the phase-flag reset this+0x174 = -1 at exit.
